sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their first defeat of the season. Despite the recent loss, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and face an Alsager side in poor form at the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture that should favor the away side's promotion hopes. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth welcome mid-table Eccleshall in a competitive midfield clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth with 19 points and strong recent form (W-W-W), host bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town, who remain without a win this season. Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir in a close contest between mid-table rivals. Barnton face Market Drayton Town in a tie between two teams in the lower half, while Shawbury United—on a run of six straight defeats—host fellow strugglers Cheadle Heath Nomads. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath in a battle at the bottom, and Brereton Social are at home to Widnes Town. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in another lower-mid-table encounter.
